_comment: Wan2.1 statistical set: 16 prompts x 2 seeds = 32 clips at a 2 s horizon (33 frames, 192x320). The first 4 prompts are those of wan_set.json. Ids are unique per (prompt, seed) so the runner keys latencies correctly. The effective sample size is 32 clips (16 prompts); per-prompt effects dominate, so report mean +- sem across clips and compare configurations pairwise. Encode prompts first: python scripts/encode_prompts.py --from-set worldoptbench/prompts/wan_set_16.json
